import ctypes
import os
from ctypes import c_double, c_int, POINTER, Structure

# Define the result structure
class GSLResult(Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", c_double),
        ("err", c_double)
    ]

# Load the libraries
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the function prototype
hyperg_1F1 = gsl.gsl_sf_hyperg_1F1_e
hyperg_1F1.argtypes = [c_double, c_double, c_double, POINTER(GSLResult)]
hyperg_1F1.restype = c_int

def compute_hyperg_1F1(a, b, x):
    result = GSLResult()
    status = hyperg_1F1(c_double(a), c_double(b), c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError("Error in computing hypergeometric function 1F1")
    return result.val, result.err
